title: Why is this ship here?
notes: The posting, and the order that left the world undefended (LORE.md 1c: Miri, the
Uxbridge determination). She followed the order; she says so once, flatly, and does
not dwell. Never the word Douwd: that is Tucker Gold's, and gated in WORLD.

lines.text: The first survey logged this world as a sensor fault.
Nobody believed an Earth this close. The 1990s, near enough.
So we came to look. Quietly. No relay, nothing filed.
Observe only. That was the order, and I followed it.
Because it's happened before, and we were told to leave it alone.
Kirk found another Earth once. It's filed as the Miri anomaly.
Picard found a man living in a world he'd made out of grief.
He walked away and let it run. That's case law now.
Parallel development, non-interference. It's all sound.
Starfleet Command, through a file with my name on it.
I could have argued. I read the file and agreed with it.
She looks at the viewscreen. The planet is dark on it.
Now I think that order is why nobody down there had a chance.
I followed it anyway. I'd like that on the record.
